name: Trying Times
label: Quest
description: Trying Times: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'll need some eggs if my plan is going tae work. Bassbeak needs a nice an' full belly--I ain't in the business of hoppin' on the back of a surly gryphon.
They need to be perfect--no cracks or anything.
Take some from the Razormaw raptors--they're known for having yolks the size of a gnome's noggin. You can find 'em in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest.
Let's make it a nice even dozen, just to be safe.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
